text:
rahul: Heads-up—new triage item. Multiple CVEs surfaced that affect our inference stack: protobuf (CVE-2026-1001), FlashAttention kernel vuln (CVE-2026-1002), and sentencepiece parsing issue (CVE-2026-1003). vLLM/Triton integrations may be impacted. Need patch plan + RBAC/audit verification. :eyes:

responding note: security-bot: Created ticket INFSEC-4123 and linked vuln DB: https://vulndb.example/INFSEC-4123 :white_check_mark:

rahul: Quick assessment: protobuf CVE is high CVSS (8.2) with remote parsing vector; exploit PoC public. FlashAttention issue is local kernel code corrupting GPU memory (7.5) — needs patched lib + rebuilt wheels for multiple CUDA versions. sentencepiece parsing is medium (5.6) and affects some tokenizer configs.

tess: For prioritization, hosted API surfaces are first priority (customer-facing). Dedicated and Private may be lower urgency depending on customer-managed packages, but we need advisories for Private customers.

lee: Agree. Proposed triage matrix in short: 1) protobuf (hosted) = P0 (patch + canary deploy within 24h). 2) FlashAttention = P0 for dedicated-hosted combined because binary wheels could crash in production GPUs; require build + QA. 3) sentencepiece = P2, schedule in normal patch window unless exploit observed.

samira: @tess @lee I can own the canary rollout for hosted. Plan: build patched images, smoke test with synthetic load, run token-level perf check, then 5% canary for 2h, then escalate to 25%/50%/100% if no regressions. I need RBAC approval for deployer role to push infra images in staging and prod.

rahul: RBAC: Temporarily grant samira the "release/deploy" scoped role for this work. @people-ops and @oncall please approve. Also we need to capture audit logs for all key operations and KMS decrypt calls during rollout for postmortem.

security-bot: Audit log export created: /audit/exports/INFSEC-4123-186501.csv (contains API keys, KMS access events, deploy events). Note: logs are immutable for 30 days.

tess: KMS note: protobuf patch requires re-signing some model artifact manifests (we checksum protobuf-based metadata). We should rotate the signing key version used for hosted images just after deploy. Lee, can you confirm the key rotation plan?

lee: Plan: 1) Build images with patched libs, 2) use existing KMS v1 to sign and publish, 3) after 100% rollout, rotate to KMS v2 and publish rotation event in roster. We'll schedule rotation 1 hour after final step. Need to ensure KMS IAM policy allows the deploy principal.

samira: Steps I'm going to run (short checklist):
- checkout release branch
- bump protobuf to patched version in requirements.txt / submodules
- rebuild wheels for CUDA 11.8/12.1 for FlashAttention patched lib
- run unit + integration + perf smoke (script: `tools/smoke_infer.sh --samples 1000`)
- push staging images to gcr: `gcr.io/redwood/inference:patch-186501`
- canary 5% -> monitor errors: `errors:>=1` triggers rollback

rahul: Add a verification post-deploy: run an automated test that forces known protobuf decoding edge cases — we should get no segfaults or parse errors. If any KMS decrypt attempts spike, the audit team will look.

tess: Communication plan: Draft advisory for Private customers (lee to draft) + hosted status page banner for the canary window. Also update internal incident channel (#incidents) if we hit rollback. Samira, ping @support when canary starts.

samira: Will do. ETA: start build in 2 hours. Posting logs to thread once staging image pushed. :lock:

deploy-bot: Build started: CI job #8754 for branch release/patch-186501. Watch: https://ci.example/jobs/8754

rahul: One more: for Dedicated pools, check Triton model repository compatibility — Triton pinned protobuf bindings may need ABI-compatible rebuild. Add to checklist: rebuild Triton containers referencing protobuf.

lee: Noted. I'll queue Triton rebuild on the same CI and mark as dependency for canary.

security-bot: Reminder: create CVE advisory entry (internal) with remediation steps + CVSS + exploit maturity. I've attached a short template to INFSEC-4123.

samira: Staging image pushed: gcr.io/redwood/inference:patch-186501-staging (CI job #8754 finished). Running smoke tests now.

tess: Good. Samira — after staging pass, initiate canary and post the canary tag here. Also record the exact KMS key version used: `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/infer-sign/cryptoKeyVersions/7`.

rahul: Thanks everyone. If we see any anomalous GPU OOMs or segfaults during canary, immediate rollback and page oncall. Otherwise, proceed with the staged rollout. I'll update INFSEC-4123 with decisions. :white_check_mark:
